title: Calculate Total Capital Deployed per Portfolio
description_markdown: Trading desk request: For BUY trades (`trade_type = 'BUY'`) in `trades`, calculate total invested capital (`SUM(shares * price_per_share)` as `total_invested`). Join with `portfolios`. Return `p.owner_name`, `p.risk_tolerance`, and `total_invested`. Order by `total_invested` DESC, `p.portfolio_id` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Capital deployed
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT p.owner_name, p.risk_tolerance, SUM(t.shares * t.price_per_share) AS total_invested FROM portfolios p JOIN trades t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, p.risk_tolerance ORDER BY total_invested DESC, p.portfolio_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Calculates cost basis for all accumulated position acquisitions.
hints: Multiply `t.shares * t.price_per_share` inside SUM.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT p.owner_name, p.risk_tolerance, SUM(t.shares * t.price_per_share) AS total_invested FROM portfolios p JOIN trades t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, p.risk_tolerance ORDER BY total_invested DESC, p.portfolio_id ASC;

solution_query: SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name, s.current_price, ROUND((d.amount_per_share / s.current_price) * 100.0, 2) AS yield_pct FROM stocks s JOIN dividends d ON s.symbol = d.symbol ORDER BY yield_pct DESC, s.symbol ASC;
solution_explanation: Calculates investment payout return ratios on market quotes.
hints: Formula: `ROUND((d.amount_per_share / s.current_price) * 100.0, 2) AS yield_pct`.

Query: SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name, s.current_price, ROUND((d.amount_per_share / s.current_price) * 100.0, 2) AS yield_pct FROM stocks s JOIN dividends d ON s.symbol = d.symbol ORDER BY yield_pct DESC, s.symbol ASC;

solution_explanation: Evaluates cashflow direction using CASE expression.

Multiply `shares * price_per_share` as `trade_value`.

Query: SELECT trade_id, symbol, trade_type, (shares * price_per_share) AS trade_value, CASE WHEN trade_type = 'BUY' THEN 'Capital Outflow' ELSE 'Capital Inflow' END AS cash_flow_type FROM trades ORDER BY trade_id ASC;

title: Compute Unrealized Capital Gains on Open Long Positions
description_markdown: Mark-to-market accounting: For all BUY orders in `trades`, calculate total unrealized paper profit or loss: `((s.current_price - t.price_per_share) * t.shares)` as `total_unrealized_gain`. solution_query: SELECT t.trade_id, t.symbol, s.company_name, t.price_per_share, s.current_price, ((s.current_price - t.price_per_share) * t.shares) AS total_unrealized_gain FROM trades t JOIN stocks s ON t.symbol = s.symbol WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY' ORDER BY total_unrealized_gain DESC, t.trade_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Multiplies price appreciation delta by position shares.
hints: Join `trades t` and `stocks s` with `WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY'`.
Compute `(s.current_price - t.price_per_share) * t.shares`.

Query: SELECT t.trade_id, t.symbol, s.company_name, t.price_per_share, s.current_price, ((s.current_price - t.price_per_share) * t.shares) AS total_unrealized_gain FROM trades t JOIN stocks s ON t.symbol = s.symbol WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY' ORDER BY total_unrealized_gain DESC, t.trade_id ASC;

solution_explanation: Applies partitioned window ranking by price within sector groups.
hints: Use `DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sector ORDER BY current_price DESC, symbol ASC)`.
Order by `sector` ASC, `sector_rank` ASC, `symbol` ASC.

Query: SELECT symbol, company_name, sector, current_price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sector ORDER BY current_price DESC, symbol ASC) AS sector_rank FROM stocks ORDER BY sector ASC, sector_rank ASC, symbol ASC;

title: Calculate Net Inventory Share Balance per Portfolio
description_markdown: Custodian ledger audit: For each portfolio and stock holding, calculate the net position shares: add bought shares (`+shares`), subtract sold shares (`-shares`). Return `p.portfolio_id`, `p.owner_name`, `t.symbol`, and `net_shares`. Order by `p.portfolio_id` ASC, `t.symbol` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Write your solution query here
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, t.symbol, SUM(CASE WHEN t.trade_type = 'BUY' THEN t.shares WHEN t.trade_type = 'SELL' THEN -t.shares ELSE 0 END) AS net_shares FROM portfolios p JOIN trades t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, t.symbol ORDER BY p.portfolio_id ASC, t.symbol ASC;
solution_explanation: Uses conditional aggregation to net buy and sell quantities.
hints: Use `SUM(CASE WHEN t.trade_type = 'BUY' THEN t.shares WHEN t.trade_type = 'SELL' THEN -t.shares ELSE 0 END)`.
Group by `p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, t.symbol`.

Query: SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, t.symbol, SUM(CASE WHEN t.trade_type = 'BUY' THEN t.shares WHEN t.trade_type = 'SELL' THEN -t.shares ELSE 0 END) AS net_shares FROM portfolios p JOIN trades t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, t.symbol ORDER BY p.portfolio_id ASC, t.symbol ASC;

title: Calculate Expected Dividend Income on Acquired Shares
description_markdown: Passive cashflow projection: For each portfolio's BUY trades, calculate total potential dividend yield income across its purchased shares: `SUM(t.shares * COALESCE(d.amount_per_share, 0.00))` as `total_div_income`. Return `p.portfolio_id`, `p.owner_name`, and `total_div_income`. Order by `total_div_income` DESC, `p.portfolio_id` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Write your solution query here

solution_query: SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, SUM(t.shares * COALESCE(d.amount_per_share, 0.00)) AS total_div_income FROM portfolios p JOIN trades t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN dividends d ON t.symbol = d.symbol WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name ORDER BY total_div_income DESC, p.portfolio_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Multiplies long shares by dividend payouts per share.
hints: Join `portfolios p` with `trades t` (`WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY'`) and `LEFT JOIN dividends d`.
Group by `p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name`.

Query: SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name, SUM(t.shares * COALESCE(d.amount_per_share, 0.00)) AS total_div_income FROM portfolios p JOIN trades t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN dividends d ON t.symbol = d.symbol WHERE t.trade_type = 'BUY' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.owner_name ORDER BY total_div_income DESC, p.portfolio_id ASC;

title: Filter Executions Priced Above Market Cross-Sectional Mean

hints: Use `WHERE price_per_share > (SELECT AVG(current_price) FROM stocks)`.
Order by `price_per_share` DESC, `trade_id` ASC.
Query: SELECT trade_id, symbol, trade_type, price_per_share FROM trades WHERE price_per_share > (SELECT AVG(current_price) FROM stocks) ORDER BY price_per_share DESC, trade_id ASC;

Order by `portfolio_id` ASC, `trade_date` ASC, `trade_id` ASC.

title: Calculate Execution Fill Price to Current Quote Percentage
description_markdown: Best execution audit: For each order in `trades`, calculate what percentage of the current market price the historical fill represented: `ROUND((t.price_per_share * 100.0) / s.current_price, 2)` as `fill_to_market_pct`. Return `t.trade_id`, `t.symbol`, `t.price_per_share`, `s.current_price`, and `fill_to_market_pct`. Order by `fill_to_market_pct` DESC, `t.trade_id` ASC.

solution_explanation: Compares executed transaction cost basis to current market value.
hints: Compute `ROUND((t.price_per_share * 100.0) / s.current_price, 2)`.

title: Audit Trade Execution Intervals Using Window LAG

starter_query:
